🔧 Scrap Mechanic Save Explorer

Runs 100% offline in your browser — your save never leaves this page.

Open a Scrap Mechanic .db save file to get started. It's found at:

%AppData%\Axolot Games\Scrap Mechanic\User\User_<yourSteamID>\Save\Survival\

Close the game before copying the file so it isn't mid-write. Nothing you open here is uploaded anywhere — this page has no server; sql.js (SQLite compiled to WebAssembly) does the reading entirely in your browser.

Part / harvestable names

1,488 item and harvestable names are built into this file already (from survival_items.lua + survival_harvestable.lua), so most UUIDs should show readable names right away.

If Scrap Mechanic updates and some UUIDs still show as "unknown", click "Load part names (.lua)" above and select the updated file(s) from your game install — this only adds/updates names for that session; to make it permanent, send the updated file back and I'll re-bake it into the page.

Save file summary

Worlds in this save

Scrap Mechanic saves contain multiple separate maps (the Overworld, plus a Warehouse/Dungeon/Underground instance for every one you've entered) — each with its own local coordinate space. Use the World selector in the header to view them separately instead of overlapping them on one map.
